  4. Store out-of-season items.
  5. Utilize the back of the door.
  6. Practice the "hanger trick."
  7. Set a regular maintenance schedule.
  8. Consider a "capsule wardrobe" approach.
  9. Keep shoes in order.
  10. Review and adjust.
  11. Make the most of vertical space.
  12. Keep a donation bin.
  13. Consider a "one in, one out" exception.
  14. Take photos and track progress.
  15. Make it a habit.
